Strategy: Bins that can still fit another item of the same size after placement are filled first, tightest among them, while bins that would become unusable for that size are heavily penalized. It differs from Best Fit whenever the tightest bin is a dead one. It may help by keeping every bin reusable for repeats, or fail by wasting tight dead bins that could have absorbed the item cheaply.

```python
def priority(item, bins):
    return [(-(r - item) if r - item >= item else (-(r - item) - 200)) for r in bins]
```
